episode.episode_title: What Meta's Online Safety Act appeal actually challenges
episode.episode_description: Meta has appealed Ofcom's decision to classify WhatsApp and Instagram as Category 1 services under the UK's Online Safety Act. We separate the additional Category 1 duties from the Act's wider obligations and explain what the appeal does—and does not—change.
episode.selection_reason: The lead verified story from today's Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.

selected_story.headline: Meta, Roblox and Quora challenge Ofcom's Category 1 decisions
selected_story.source_title: Meta challenges Ofcom's OSA categorization of WhatsApp and Instagram imposing additional regulations; Roblox and Quora are also challenging their categorization (Daniel Thomas/Financial Times)

short.title: Meta, Roblox and Quora challenge Ofcom's Category 1 decisions
short.description:
Category 1 designation adds duties including protections against fraudulent advertising and increased reporting on illegal-content handling. The appeals test how Ofcom has applied those additional duties; they do not suspend the Online Safety Act as a whole.
